claims.statement: Ethereum Mainnet is the primary public Ethereum production network.

evidence.note: The official Ethereum developer page identifies Mainnet as the primary public production blockchain.

claims.statement: Ethereum Mainnet uses EIP-155 chain ID 1.

evidence.locator: Parameters and List of Chain ID's
evidence.note: Final EIP-155 assigns chain ID 1 to Ethereum mainnet.
The fixed-block Ethereum observation independently recorded eth_chainId 1.

claims.statement: Ethereum Mainnet uses Ether (ETH) as its native gas currency with 18 decimal places.

evidence.locator: What is ether? and Denominations of ether
evidence.note: The official developer page names Ether/ETH as the transaction-fee currency and defines one wei as 10^-18 ether.

claims.statement: Etherscan is an Ethereum block explorer at https://etherscan.io.

evidence.note: The official developer page links Etherscan at the canonical URL for Ethereum account inspection.

claims.statement: This record exposes only the EVM and Ethereum JSON-RPC capabilities needed by MDK cross-chain workflows.

evidence.note: EIP-155 defines the Ethereum transaction chain-ID semantics used by the EVM profile.
The bounded RPC observation establishes the eth_chainId capability used by the current workflow.

limitations: Qualified registry provenance review acceptance covers this chain identity and capability profile only; it does not create provider, bridge-route, protocol, or writer support.
No Ethereum RPC endpoint is selected or supported by this record.
The EVM profile does not claim every optional JSON-RPC method, archive access, subscription, batching, or provider capability.
